 ORDER

This appeal by the claimants under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 14.02.2020 passed by Addl. MACT, Dharampuri, district Dhar in MACC No.27/2017 seeking enhancement of the amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the death of deceased Varun, the Tribunal has awarded a compensation amount of Rs.3 lakh along with interest.

The break up of the compensation amount is as under:
Loss of dependency -Rs.2,70,000/- (i.e. 3000 x12=36000x15-1/2) Loss of estate -Rs.15.000/-

Funeral expenses -Rs.15,000/-
 -----------------
 TOTAL Rs.3,00,000/-
 ============
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in awarding adequate amount of compensation and the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The Tribunal has awarded lower compensation in other conventional heads, hence prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the matter.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance company argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the matter which does not call for any interference by this Court.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the Tribunal has not awarded just and proper amount of compensation in the matter.

The compensation awarded under the conventional heads is on the lower side, hence the compensation amount deserves to be enhanced as under:
Loss of dependency -Rs.2,70,000/- (i.e. Rs.3000x12=36000x15-1/2) Loss of consortium -Rs.1,20,000 (4000x3) Funeral expenses -Rs.15,000/-
 Loss of estate -Rs.15,000/-
Smt. Ushabai vs Rajesh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88051897/
2  ---------------------
 TOTAL Rs.4,20,000/-
 =============
Hence, the appellants are entitled to the total compensation of Rs.4,20,000/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.3,00,000/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.1,20,000/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
Accordingly, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.1,20,000/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE hk/
